answer: Latency triangulation: five beacon servers on different continents each time a short challenge reply from every identity. Round-trip times form a fingerprint of where an agent really runs, so 300 clones on one rack light up as a single island on the map, matching to the millisecond. Matched groups lose their ivory-clean standing and face an extra grading pass by random peers before rewards settle. Assuming about $5 a month per separate cloud host, scattering 300 clones costs about $1,500 a month instead of one $5 box; honest agents pay nothing extra.
